evidence_inputs: The locked read exists as one production module (nova/equilibrium/support_read.py) but is not on the production map or solve path; the legacy partition is the only support reader a flux-only caller has, so the operator rewire is blocked on a ruling about how the solve carries the state moments.
Booking is 99 percent of the step at every rung and is the next cost target, not the fixed points or the membership.
Both arms share the same 6 failing tests/test_current_book_fragments.py ids and the fragment's timeouts; they predate this node.

findings.text: _support_partition still calls self._fixed_design_read (the legacy spline-clip support and fixed-design read), and the production gs.apply call sites at :4056, :4109 and :4133 pass no moments, so support_read is reached only from scripts/prototypes/support/read_route_rows.py:152 and the tests; the goal ('route the forward map and solve support through the locked read and current.book') and done_when (1) 'no second, parallel support path' and (2) 'legacy spline-clip support and fixed-design read off the solve path' are unmet.

done_when (5) requires a test that would fail if the legacy support partition were reinstated, run as the negative control; the run's controls (negative/negative-gs.log, negative/negative-support-read-2.log) exercise support_read.read's validity guard and gs.apply's moments branch only, and no test reddens on reinstating ForwardFluxOperator._support_partition, so the declared negative-control string is unfulfilled.

the fragment records plan-verdict partial and the blocker, but the manifest status is 'complete'; the record overstates the node's state, since done_when (1),(2),(5) are unmet and the contract asks a worker to set a recognised terminal status that reflects that.
